problems: Visual layout lacks modern glassmorphism / contemporary hierarchy, lowering instant brand trust.

design.quickFix: Deploy a clean, mobile-first design with high-contrast typography, clear value pillars, and trust badges.

problems: Missing responsive viewport tag; page renders as a shrunk desktop view on smartphones.

problems: Uncompressed image assets and render-blocking scripts delay First Contentful Paint (FCP).

speed.quickFix: Utilize zero-dependency static HTML/CSS delivery with optimized web fonts for sub-500ms load times.

problems: Missing localized meta description and target keyword clusters for "trade in Seattle, WA".

problems: Phone numbers are plain unclickable text; mobile users cannot tap-to-call immediately.
